desc: The Frigidaire 30" Front Control Electric Range with the EvenTemp cooktop element delivers consistent results every time, because it reduces hot and cold spots in your pan. Plus, enjoy easier cleanup with our Steam Clean cycle that provides a quick 30-minute oven cleaning that's chemical-free, odor-free and fast.
hl: Heat is evenly distributed across the element's surface, which reduces hot spots and cold areas in your pan.
Designed to meet all of your cooking needs with a powerful 3,200 Watt EvenTemp® Element, Dual Expandable Element, and convenient Keep Warm Zone.
Designed to deliver even baking results, every time.
A light, 30-minute oven cleaning that's chemical-free, odor-free and fast.
Our convenient 2-in-1 element expands from 6" for smaller pots to 9" for larger cookware, providing more cooktop flexibility.
Redesigned to be even wider - allowing you to store any unused oven racks, baking trays and more!
